candidates.title: The Dome That Would Not Follow the Stars
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the observatory dome stopped rotating during a night survey during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they restarted the motor but the dome stalled at the same point; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a bent guide wheel caught on a damaged section of track; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they replaced the wheel and tested a complete dome rotation, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Crates That Arrived Empty
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered harvest crates reached the barn with their lids closed but fruit missing during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they tightened the lids but the losses continued; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a loose panel in the cart floor let fruit roll out along the road; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they repaired the cart floor and collected the fallen fruit, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Letter That Appeared Blank
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the archive's emergency instructions looked blank under ordinary lamps during a power outage, leaving the community helpers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they copied the page onto fresh paper but no words appeared; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized the archivist discovered that the writing used a pigment visible under angled blue light; they planned a safer joint response.
With the community helpers watching, they photographed the recovered text and made accessible permanent copies, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
